Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.paint

Class ShapeTool

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.paint.AbstractTool
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.paint.ShapeTool
All Implemented Interfaces:
Tool
Direct Known Subclasses:
EllipseTool, LineTool, RectangleTool
public abstract class ShapeTool extends AbstractTool
Base for the drag-out two-point shapes (line, rectangle, ellipse). A press sets the anchor and snapshots the layer; each drag updates the opposite corner and repaints so preview(java.awt.Graphics2D, org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.paint.PaintContext) can rubber-band the shape over the composite; the release commits the final shape into the active layer (filled and/or stroked per the tool state) as one undoable edit.
